headline: Linn Mercy Rages While Expanse Fights On
war_summary: Since the last filing Linn Mercy has surged to the fore with ten changes in two hours and twenty-seven on the day about Lathair and Rotdust, last at 17:32, holding ten Colonial to one in no-man's-land amid 4,726 Colonial and 7,988 Warden casualties on the day with losses still accelerating. The Weathered Expanse remains in motion with two changes in two hours and fourteen on the day about Crow's Nest and Frostmarch, last at 18:10, standing six Warden to three Colonial with 12,633 Colonial and 14,178 Warden losses on the day. Stonecradle and Stlican Shelf have gone quiet in the past two hours after six in six hours and two in six hours respectively, though both still report sharply accelerating casualty rates. Oarbreaker shows three changes in six hours about Grisly Refuge, last at 15:57. Dead Lands and Mooring County remain quiet in the last two hours, while Callahan's Passage reports 5,628 Colonial and 4,637 Warden losses on the day with no base changes.
